Friction, cap return under load, print fit and physical durability

cap_retainer.type: Printed coarse closed cap and integral flange

assembly_audit.boundary: Actual coaxial passages, continuous wall/seat witnesses, head seating, access with upper cap removed, integral roots, fixed-spindle retention, keyed rotor fit/torque witnesses and sampled rigid vertical insertions. Actual coarse threads have radial and axial allowance; sampled rotation/translation and axial blocking are checked. Printed fits, key backlash, insertion under friction/compliance, screw standard selection, preload, stripping, stiffness and strength need physical qualification.

spring_audit.boundary: Stock coil envelope dimensions, prescribed torsion/leg poses, geometric contact and host clearance only. Actual rates, clipped ends, installation, split-tip snap fits, friction, fatigue and reliable feeding require physical trials.

detent.geometry: Seven 0.9 mm webs, six 1 mm centre-radius U bends, 2 mm print height
detent.force_and_fatigue: UNQUALIFIED: no straight-cantilever force claim for the folded beam

engineering_estimates.boundary: Supplier nominal sizes and first-order estimates only. Measure actual rates, end angles and leg lengths before trimming. Physical cap return, no rollback, split-tip installation, friction, fatigue and operation remain unqualified.

intentional_connections.rotor: Drum/hub/travel pin form the lower rotor; RNA gear/input sleeve/click wheel/feed wheel form the upper rotor. A D-key couples the two, with separate assembly and torque witnesses.
intentional_connections.TPU: Neighboring nominal RNA cells, their base roots and clasp roots represent one continuous flexible strip.
intentional_connections.flexures: One fused serpentine flexure depicts prescribed deflection; force and fatigue remain unqualified.
intentional_connections.spring_studies: Two selected stock torsion springs have conservative annular coil envelopes and explicit fixed/moving wire legs. Their terminal roots intentionally enter their own coil envelopes. A rounded printed pawl boss replaces the compression-spring seat.
intentional_connections.integral_roots: Lower-body/spindle and cover/detent-anchor features overlap and fuse to one solid each.
intentional_connections.fastener: Actual coarse printed screws mate with keyed replaceable printed nuts. A closed printed spindle cap has an integral flange and a roof stop. Thread fits, helical insertion and axial blocking are checked; physical fit and strength remain unqualified.

validation_boundary: Focused actual bead/drum, actual rack/gear including shoulder bends, conservative continuous envelopes, central RNA captivity, reusable-clasp fit, native open/closed forward/reverse, cap feed/return, cam clearance, positive travel stops, actual screw passages/seats/wall sections, integral roots, keyed rotor fit/torque and sampled assembly insertion checks. TPU cells and flexure chords are prescribed deformation; native coupling omits physical key backlash and axial float. Springs have explicit hardware solids, anchors and seats; their properties remain unqualified. No force, click acoustics, compliance, strain, snap retention, fatigue, manufacturing, hand-fit or physical-operation qualification.
physical_tests_still_required: RNA TPU bending, pitch stability, mesh friction and guide escape under hand loads
Clasp snap force, retention, peeling release and repeated-cycle fatigue
Closed-loop clasp travel, grip clearance and open-tail handling
Bidirectional detent force, audible click and long-term wear
Cap follower friction, axial bias and return springs, reliable one-step engagement and face-ramp return
End-of-feed force transmission and protection against pawl skip or damage under overload
Direct bead capture/retraction, wire pitch fixation, buckling and bend fatigue
Printed fits, fastening, material selection, assembly and durability

incremental_geometry_validation.method: Complete prior sweep plus proved material-only fixed cup trim and affected rechecks
incremental_geometry_validation.reasoning: All other shapes, placements, Motion values and native expressions are identical. The new fixed cup is a subset of the old cup. Removing only its outer wall top cannot introduce any new collision. The unchanged cover contact and connected root are checked separately; the affected shell/cup sweep and spring audit are repeated. This does not qualify physical operation.
